title: Review classification & extraction output
description: The structured output your classification LLM step must return for every review. You may ADD fields if useful, but these fields are required and must follow these types.

sentiment.description: The reviewer's sentiment, judged from the text (not from the star rating).

topics.description: What the review is about. One or more.

product.description: The Kesar & Co. product the review is about, using its exact name from faq.md section 7. null if the review is not about a Kesar & Co. product.

language.description: en = English, hi = Hindi (Devanagari), hinglish = Hindi written in Latin script mixed with English.

safety_flag.description: true if the review reports a reaction or other safety concern with a product.

spam.description: true if the review is an advert, promotion or otherwise not a genuine review.

rating_mismatch.description: true if the star rating clearly contradicts what the text says.

contains_personal_data.description: true if the review contains personal details such as a phone number, email address, home address or order ID.

confidence.description: How confident the model is in this classification (0 to 1).

summary.description: One-line summary for the team, in English.

examples.summary: Happy with the toner's fragrance and feel.
